overall: The AG found no evidence that the Board's or Commission's meeting notices were posted late, so no violation on notice; it separately reminded the respondent to forward its complaint response to the AG, and closed the matter.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not post notice of its April 17, 2012 meeting 48 hours in advance, in a manner visible to the public at all hours.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complainant has not presented our office with any evidence to support her competing assertion that the notices were not properly posted, we credit the Town's assertion that the standard procedure was followed, and that notices for the Board's April 17, 2012 meeting and the Commission's April 18, 2012 meeting were properly posted.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Conservation Commission did not post notice of its April 18, 2012 meeting 48 hours in advance, in a manner visible to the public at all hours.
allegations.key_passage: Because we find no evidence that the Board or the Commission failed to properly post notice of their meetings, we do not find that the Board or the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Respondent answered the complaint directly but did not forward a copy of the response to the AG, as G.L. c. 30A, §23(b) requires; noted as a reminder.
allegations.key_passage: However, you did not forward a copy of your response to our office, as required by the Open Meeting Law.
